prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling medieval village square during late afternoon. In the center foreground, a merchant in a brown tunic hands a clay jug of wine to a customer wearing a green hooded cloak. The customer holds out a silver coin in exchange. To the left, a blacksmith leans on his hammer, wiping sweat from his brow while watching a child feed apples to a gray horse tied to a post. The horse lowers its head to eat from the child’s outstretched hand. On the right, two women in long woolen dresses carry a heavy basket of bread between them, walking toward a stone fountain. A dog with spotted fur runs past them, chasing a rolling hoop. In the background, a town crier stands on a wooden crate, pointing at a parchment scroll attached to a pillar. Villagers gather around him, some looking up attentively while others converse in small groups. Stone buildings with timber frames surround the square, their windows reflecting the golden sunlight. Pigeons perch on the roof edges, observing the activity below. The lighting casts long shadows across the cobblestones, emphasizing the texture of the stones and the rough fabrics of the clothing.
